title: Autocorrelation-at-origin (proven L^inf brick) x resultant-threshold point-count bounds the char-p energy ANOMALY
evidence: Three exact-integer probes in scripts/probes/_407_conn/ at PROPER-subgroup prize-shaped primes (n=2^mu | q-1, q~n^4-5, n<<sqrt(q)) + a regime-independent structural argument. (A) IDENTITY (probe_C059_anomaly_decomp.py): the anomaly E_r^Fp - E_r^char0 EQUALS the spurious mass Sum_{alpha!=0, p|N(alpha)} (diff-mass) EXACTLY (MATCH=True every case: n=8 q=4129/32801, n=16 q=65537/1048609, r=2..4) where E_r^char0 is computed in Z[zeta_n]=Z[x]/Phi_n and E_r^Fp=R_r(0) in F_q. This confirms the decomposition the connection asserts. (B) PER-POINT CAP (the autocorr brick AutocorrelationMax.autocorr_le_autocorr_zero): R_r(z)<=R_r(0) holds in every case (max off-diag strictly < R0). Crucially the probe also pins R_r(0) == E_r^Fp EXACTLY in every row -- the autocorr-at-origin IS the entire char-p energy. (C) DECISIVE VACUITY (probe_C059_vacuity_argument.py): since the cap value R_r(0)=E_r^Fp, the C059 bound anomaly <= R_r(0)*#contrib is non-vacuous (better than the trivial anomaly <= E_r^Fp) ONLY when #contrib=0; when #contrib>=1 it is >= R_r(0)=E_r^Fp >= anomaly, i.e. STRICTLY WEAKER than trivial. Forced-contributor demos give looseness factors 9.6, 16.6, 32.7, 90.5 growing with the count (n=8/16, r=2/3). (D) #contrib=0 is exactly the clean range = no_spurious_tuple_of_lt_prime, which already gives anomaly=0 with NO use of the autocorr brick. The in-tree honesty docstring of CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold.lean already states this clean range is VACUOUS in the prize regime (phi(n)=n/2, p^{1/phi(n)}->1). Consistent with DISPROOF_LOG O134/O135: the prize-regime anomaly is genuinely NONZERO and grows with r (+33.6% at n=64,r=5), driven by exactly the p|N(alpha) count -- the object C059 leaves open.
reduced_to: The anomaly-decomposition identity (anomaly = spurious p|N(alpha) mass) is settled and exact, and BOTH cited bricks are genuinely proven (Cauchy-Schwarz autocorr cap; resultant norm threshold). The remaining open content reduces to EXACTLY the count #{ nonzero balanced-2r cyclotomic states alpha with p | N(alpha) } = #{ contributing sublattice points of mu_n in the 2r-box } -- the Bourgain-Shkredov equidistribution count. The autocorr brick provides NO leverage on this count because its per-point cap value equals the whole energy.
wall: W-anomaly / Bourgain-Shkredov equidistribution of mu_n in the 2r-box (= the same deep-moment / BGK sqrt-cancellation core, faces 3<->4 of the open core). The autocorr brick caps each spurious term by R_r(0)=E_r^Fp, the entire char-p energy, so cap*count >= E_r^Fp >= anomaly whenever count>=1; the fusion welds straight back to the open count without bounding it.
honest_note: Honest OPEN/no-progress-beyond-restating, NOT a closure and NOT a refutation of any lemma. What is genuinely affirmed (PARTIAL-positive): the anomaly = spurious-mass identity is exact (machine-verified), both bricks are real in-tree proven theorems, and the decomposition is the correct one. The connection's THESIS -- that fusing the two proven caps yields a useful upper bound on the anomaly that 'localizes' the open factor -- is the part that fails: the autocorr cap R_r(0) is not a small per-point quantity, it is the entire energy E_r^Fp, so the product R_r(0)*#contrib is informative only when #contrib=0 (the clean range, already handled by the resultant threshold ALONE and known-vacuous in the prize regime). The brick-fusion therefore adds nothing over no_spurious_tuple_of_lt_prime; the lone open input (the Bourgain-Shkredov count) is untouched. Caveats: my n=8,16 prize-shaped primes happened to give anomaly=0 even when (2r)^phi>q (the specific q did not divide a specific N(alpha)); the nonzero-anomaly ground truth is the DISPROOF_LOG n=64 census, not re-run here. The structural vacuity argument (cap=whole energy) is regime-independent and does not depend on exhibiting a nonzero anomaly at the prize scale. Did not attempt Lean (the proposed energy_anomaly_le_autocorr_times_latticeCount would be provable but vacuous-in-regime, so not worth landing). #400-trap honored: no small-q flatness claim made.
